player_prompt.intro: Cjk: You are playing Countdown numbers game! Goal: Combine number using +, -, *, / to reach the target. Action format: [i j op] where i, j is indices and op is the operation. Example:[0 2 *] multiplies number at index 0 with number at Index 2. Division must result in whole numbers only.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Invalid indices. Must be different and in range 0-{max_index}
